question_en: Give me the best English-language feature-length comedies from the 1950s
question_fr: Donnez-moi les meilleures comédies de long métrage en langue anglaise des années 1950.
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE FROM T_WC_T2S_MOVIE JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE.ID_MOVIE WHERE T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_GENRE.ID_GENRE = 35 AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ORIGINAL_LANGUAGE = 'en' AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IS_SHORT_FILM = 0 AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.RELEASE_YEAR BETWEEN 1949 AND 1960 ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.IMDB_RATING_WEIGHTED DESC LIMIT 8
